Name: No Coal For Machines
Author: voiddreams
Description:
Allows you to remove the need for coal with the three vanilla machines that require it. Optionally, you can replace the coal with 5 or 10 wood for the fish smoker and furnace, and 5, 10, 15, or 30 for the heavy furnace. Each option is separate from each other - for example, you could use no fuel with the fish smoker, wood with the standard furnace, and coal for the heavy furnace.

Suggested [url=https://github.com/StardewModders/mod-ideas/issues/1202]here[/url]

COMPATIBILITY:
- Compatible with Automate
- Not compatible with any other mods that replace the fuel for the listed machines, or that rewrite them entirely.
- Will not affect any modded machines that use coal.
